comment: uhitm.c passive() AD_ACID. A 10-hit-point Tourist in debug mode creates an ochre jelly and fights it bare-handed with F. The seventh blow hits, and the jelly's passive acid splash takes the hero to 0 hit points through mhitu.c mdamageu(), whose done() asks "Die?". Answering y ends the game in really_done(), which never returns, so C draws neither passive()'s rn2(30) for erode_armor() nor anything after it. The q skips the disclosure questions and the space declines bones.
